note: Tunisia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 4 months (Canada, Germany), 90 days, 2 months (Bulgaria) or 15 days in 180 (Iran and Iraq, tourists); everyone else needs a visa from a mission (Cyprus isn't on the list). Organised tours with a hotel voucher for some nationalities aren't modelled; Tunisia's e-Visa tender failed in August 2025. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
